title: Source map reference in a served script
description: The served script ends with a sourceMappingURL comment. Browsers and attackers can fetch the map and recover original source, comments, and internal paths.
remediation: Do not publish source maps for production bundles, or restrict them to authenticated tooling (maps kept off the public origin).
limitation: Marker on one body: it only applies to script bodies the scanner captured. It does not prove the map is reachable.
